description.zh: 数据集ID。如何获取数据集ID，详情请参见[ListDatasets](~~457222~~)。
description.en: The dataset ID. You can call [ListDatasets](~~457222~~) to obtain the dataset ID.

description.zh: 数据集版本。版本号需要大于v1，v1版本会在删除数据集的时候同步删除。
description.en: The dataset version name. The version number must be later than v1. Version v1 can only be deleted when the dataset is deleted.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun aiworkspace delete-dataset-version --dataset-id d-lfd60v0p0000ujtsdx --version-name v2 --region cn-hangzhou
